data.one_liner: An IndexedStack widget that loads children lazily only when needed.
data.what_it_does: Exposes an IndexedStack alternative that lazily loads its children instead of rendering all of them at once. It uses the same API as IndexedStack requiring a list of children and an active index.
use_when: You have a lot of children in an IndexedStack and want to avoid loading them all at once.
You have children that load content asynchronously and need to be deferred until selected.
avoid_when: You need standard IndexedStack behavior where all child states must remain active simultaneously from initial render.
strengths: Improves performance by lazy-loading children in an IndexedStack.
Drop-in API compatibility with the standard IndexedStack widget.
weaknesses: State of non-selected children might not be initialized until they are activated for the first time.
data.minimal_example:
LazyIndexedStack(
  index: index,
  children: List.generate(3, (i) => Text('$i')),
)
